{{Quote|The favors I would have to give him now&hellip; it would be above and beyond the call of duty.''"<br />"''Never stopped you before, Captain.''"<br />"''The old man's depraved! And the years have not been kind to him.|Lorant and Pierce|<ref name="Captain Lorant" />}}
'''Galvan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lorant]] was a favorite of Galvan's by the [[Time/Legends|time]] he was approaching retirement, and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Pierce]] was confident that Lorant could manipulate Galvan into giving his team reinforcements.

==Personality and traits==
Moff Galvan was susceptible to promotion of those who seduced him. He was mentioned by [[Pierce]] to be "more interested in Twi'leks these days", although that may have been a jab at Lorant, who he was coercing into seducing Galvan again in order to gain more manpower for a black ops assault on the Bastion.
